[[Mubata]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for other [[item]]s of value.

==Locations==
*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|Command Post}} (only after the following quest)
**{{NPC location|Sunward Marches}} (during [[Building the Base: The Meeting]])

==Dialogue==
:Quest:
:''"My father is the wisest man I know. I do not doubt for a moment his intuition regarding [[Varesh Ossa|Warmarshal Varesh]]. Long have I studied with my father to learn the great secrets of our world. I am beginning to see why he yearns for a new Kourna."''

:Command post:
:''"We certainly live in interesting times. At least, that's my father says. I hope to help pen the histories of this era, so I'm eager any tales of your adventures."''
